title: Work bound for matrix–vector multiplication
statement: Let $k,n,a,b$ be natural numbers satisfying $1\le k\le n$, $a>0$, and $2a\le b$. Set $s=\lceil nb/a\rceil$, and let $W$ be the work of the executable matrix–vector multiplication with $n$ columns and $(k-1)\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)+1$ rows, where each traversal step costs twice the row count plus one. Then $W\le 9(s+1)^3$.
